messages:
elena: Heads-up — ran into multiple places where we use 'model revision' and 'model version' interchangeably in the docs and SDK snippets. This is confusing for customers and shows up in the glossary as duplicate entries. Can we pick a canonical term and schedule a small sweep?

matt: +1. I think 'model version' reads clearer for users (semantic parity with releases). We should update the glossary, the Quickstart snippets, and add an entry in the migration guide.

sarah: Agree on 'model version'. Proposal: do an initial PR that updates the glossary + top-level overview pages, then smaller follow-ups for SDK snippets so we can coordinate with the SDK owners. Plan: canary PR -> review -> batch rename on merge.

kevin_devx: I patched a quick grep/sed script that finds common variants. Sharing here so doc contributors can run locally before opening PRs: 

```bash
# find lines mentioning the old term and propose replacements (dry run)
grep -Rin "model revision" docs/ | sed -n '1,200p'
# to replace in files (run after review)
sed -i.bak 's/model revision/model version/g' $(git ls-files docs | grep -E '\\.md$')
```

kevin_devx: Note — SDK param names will need a different cadence. For JS/py SDKs we should open matching PRs with `deprecated` aliases: keep old param for one release, warn in logs, then remove in the next major.

elena: Good call. For the migration guide, can we add a short snippet showing the param alias approach? e.g.: 

```js
// new param: modelVersion (preferred)
// alias kept for backward compat: modelRevision (deprecated)
function callModel(opts) {
  const model = opts.modelVersion ?? opts.modelRevision;
  if (opts.modelRevision) console.warn('[docs] modelRevision is deprecated; use modelVersion');
  // ...
}
```

sarah: I'll open the glossary + overview PR (small, targeted) — will tag @matt and @kevin_devx for review. Can someone run the link checker after my PR?

doc-bot: automated link-check: after scanning current branch — 3 broken links found in 'usage/migrations' and 'sdk/snippets'. See report: https://ci.redwood/links/2380076543-report

matt: I'll run the link checker once your PR is up and comment with any false positives. @kevin_devx can you file a short runbook for SDK owners on how to add the alias and deprecation warning? We can paste that into the migration guide.

kevin_devx: Yep. I'll draft the runbook and include example diffs for JS/py. ETA EOD tomorrow.

elena: Action items recap: 1) Sarah opens glossary+overview PR (canary), 2) Matt runs link-check and verifies, 3) Kevin drafts SDK runbook + sed snippet, 4) follow-up PRs for snippet updates coordinated with SDK owners. I'll update the docs board tickets and assign. Thanks team :thumbsup:

sarah: On it — PR expected in next 2 hours.

matt: Thanks — will review quickly. :eyes:
